faqSections.sectionSubtitle: The core value proposition and biggest conversion drivers.

questions.question: What makes SyncQ different from traditional event platforms?
questions.answer: Unlike traditional event platforms focused only on registrations or ticketing, SyncQ is built as a real-time digital operating system for live events. It combines instant QR onboarding, no-install access, interactive maps, live schedules, announcements, crowd analytics, AI-powered venue digitization, and white-label branding into a single platform designed for modern high-scale events.

questions.question: Do attendees need to install an app?
questions.answer: No. SyncQ is completely no-install. Attendees simply scan a QR code or open a link to access the event instantly in their browser.

questions.question: How quickly can I launch my first app?
questions.answer: You can launch your first interactive event app in under 5 minutes.

questions.question: Can non-technical organizers use SyncQ?
questions.answer: Yes. The setup process is designed to feel as simple as filling out a form.

questions.question: Can SyncQ handle 5,000+ attendees?
questions.answer: Yes. SyncQ is designed to support large-scale events with thousands of attendees.

questions.question: What types of events can use SyncQ Events?
questions.answer: SyncQ Events is designed for college fests, conferences, hackathons, corporate events, weddings, cultural festivals, exhibitions, and any large-scale event requiring schedules, announcements, maps, and real-time coordination.

questions.question: Will this work on phones without installing an app?
questions.answer: Yes. SyncQ works directly from the browser without installation.

questions.question: Can I use my own branding?
questions.answer: Yes. SyncQ supports custom branding including colors, splash screens, and QR branding.

faqSections.sectionSubtitle: What attendees and organizers experience in real time.

questions.question: Can schedules update in real time?
questions.answer: Yes. Organizers can update schedules live during the event.

questions.question: What if my event schedule changes live?
questions.answer: Schedules can be updated instantly and attendees are automatically notified in real time.

questions.question: Do attendees get notified automatically about session changes?
questions.answer: Yes. Attendees receive automatic live notifications for schedule or venue updates.

questions.question: How are announcements delivered?
questions.answer: Announcements are delivered through browser push notifications, in-app alerts, and live notification banners. SMS and email support are being developed.

questions.question: Can announcements target specific attendee groups?
questions.answer: Yes. Organizers can target announcements to specific attendee cohorts such as VIPs, volunteers, or workshop attendees.

questions.question: Can maps show live crowd density and capacity?
questions.answer: Yes. SyncQ supports live crowd-density and venue-capacity insights.

questions.question: Can attendees navigate between locations?
questions.answer: Yes. Attendees can navigate between stages, halls, workshops, food zones, and other mapped areas.

questions.question: Can sessions include speaker bios, files, and links?
questions.answer: Yes. Sessions can include speaker bios, PDFs, images, files, links, and additional resources.

questions.question: Can attendees save schedules and reminders personally?
questions.answer: Yes. Attendees can bookmark sessions, save schedules, and receive reminders for upcoming events.

questions.question: Can attendees bookmark sessions?
questions.answer: Yes. Attendees can bookmark sessions and save reminders.

questions.question: Is calendar integration available?
questions.answer: Yes. SyncQ supports calendar integrations.

questions.question: Is multilingual support available?
questions.answer: Yes. SyncQ supports multilingual functionality.

faqSections.sectionSubtitle: Operational intelligence and live event management.

questions.question: What analytics do organizers get?
questions.answer: Organizers receive analytics including registrations, attendance, footfall tracking, crowd density, engagement, venue occupancy, and session popularity.

questions.question: Can organizers track footfall, popular events, engagement, and announcement performance?
questions.answer: Yes. SyncQ provides real-time insights into crowd movement, popular sessions, engagement levels, and announcement reach.

questions.question: Are analytics available in real time?
questions.answer: Yes. Analytics and engagement metrics are updated live during events.

questions.question: What future features are planned?
questions.answer: Upcoming features include live polls, sponsor booths, live streaming, AI-powered recommendations, advanced analytics, networking, and gamification.

questions.question: How are venue maps uploaded?
questions.answer: Organizers upload venue images or layouts and SyncQ's AI system converts them into interactive digital maps.

questions.question: How many attendees can SyncQ support simultaneously?
questions.answer: SyncQ is designed to support large-scale events with thousands of simultaneous attendees.

questions.question: Can reports be exported after the event?
questions.answer: Yes. Aggregate analytics reports can be exported after the event.

faqSections.sectionSubtitle: Make the platform feel fully yours.

questions.question: What branding elements are customizable?
questions.answer: Brand colors, splash screens, QR branding, and event identity customization are supported.

questions.question: Can organizers use custom domains or subdomains?
questions.answer: Yes. Custom domains and subdomains are available depending on the selected plan.

questions.question: Will Powered by SyncQ branding appear?
questions.answer: Depending on the selected plan, subtle Powered by SyncQ branding may appear.

questions.question: Can each event under one organization have different branding?
questions.answer: Not currently, but this feature is planned for future versions.

faqSections.sectionSubtitle: Simple setup for organizers of any scale.

questions.question: How long does setup usually take?
questions.answer: Setup typically takes less than 5–10 minutes depending on event complexity.

questions.question: How difficult is setup?
questions.answer: Setup is extremely simple and designed even for non-technical organizers.

questions.question: Can organizers create multiple events under one account?
questions.answer: Yes. Organizers can manage multiple events under one account depending on their selected plan.

questions.question: Are there different admin roles and permissions?
questions.answer: Yes. SyncQ supports multiple admin roles and permission levels.

questions.question: Can multiple organizers collaborate live?
questions.answer: Yes. Multiple organizers can collaborate together on event management.

questions.question: Is there a dashboard for volunteers and staff?
questions.answer: Currently organizer access is prioritized, but additional staff permissions are being expanded.

questions.question: Do you provide onboarding support for large events?
questions.answer: Yes. Dedicated onboarding and setup support is available for large events.

faqSections.sectionSubtitle: Flexible access for organizations and campuses.

questions.question: Can I try SyncQ before committing?
questions.answer: Yes. Trial access and demo experiences will be available.

questions.question: Is pricing subscription-based or per event?
questions.answer: Both subscription-based and per-event pricing models are available.

questions.question: Is SyncQ free for student organizations?
questions.answer: Selected student organizations may receive free early-access plans and discounted pricing.

questions.question: Do student organizations get discounts?
questions.answer: Yes. Student organizations and campus communities can receive discounted pricing.

questions.question: Is there a free tier?
questions.answer: Currently there is no public free tier available.

questions.question: What happens after early access ends?
questions.answer: After early access, organizers will be able to create events through their accounts and access organizer tools after selecting a plan.

questions.question: Are there attendee limits in free plans?
questions.answer: Yes. Limits may apply depending on the selected plan.

questions.question: Is attendee data secure and encrypted?
questions.answer: Yes. Attendee data is securely stored and encrypted using industry-standard security practices.

questions.question: Does the platform work offline if internet connectivity is weak?
questions.answer: Yes. Basic event information remains temporarily available offline and syncs automatically once connectivity is restored.

questions.question: What happens if internet connectivity drops during the event?
questions.answer: Event data is temporarily stored locally and automatically synced once internet connectivity returns.

questions.question: Which browsers and devices are supported?
questions.answer: SyncQ supports modern browsers including Chrome, Safari, Edge, and Firefox across phones, tablets, and desktops.

questions.question: Is SyncQ GDPR compliant?
questions.answer: GDPR compliance and additional privacy standards are currently being implemented.

questions.question: Is there scaling and rate-limiting protection?
questions.answer: Backend rate limiting exists for infrastructure protection, but there are no attendee-facing limits.

questions.question: Can organizers update maps live during the event?
questions.answer: Live map updates are currently being developed and will be supported in future releases.

questions.question: Does indoor navigation work?
questions.answer: Indoor navigation depends on venue size, layout complexity, and device GPS or network conditions.

questions.question: Can organizers create parallel tracks and workshops?
questions.answer: Yes. SyncQ supports multiple simultaneous tracks and workshops depending on the selected plan.

questions.question: Do users need notification permissions enabled?
questions.answer: Yes. Users are prompted to enable notifications for real-time event updates.

questions.question: Can organizers schedule announcements beforehand?
questions.answer: Yes. Announcements can be scheduled in advance or sent instantly during the event.

questions.question: Is there an emergency alert mode?
questions.answer: Not currently, but emergency alert functionality is planned for future releases.

questions.question: Can QR-based check-ins be done through the platform?
questions.answer: Yes. QR-based attendee check-ins are fully supported.

questions.question: Does SyncQ support ticketing and registrations?
questions.answer: Currently SyncQ focuses on the live event experience. Ticketing and registration features may be added in future versions.

questions.question: Are attendee analytics included?
questions.answer: Yes. Organizers receive attendee analytics and event insights.

questions.question: Can organizers export attendee data?
questions.answer: Aggregate event data can be exported, but individual attendee information is not shared for privacy reasons.

questions.question: Does SyncQ integrate with existing registration systems?
questions.answer: Integration support is currently being developed.

questions.question: Will SyncQ expand beyond event management?
questions.answer: Currently SyncQ is focused on building the best possible event operating system.

questions.question: Is SyncQ connected to the larger SyncQ OS ecosystem?
questions.answer: Yes. SyncQ Events is part of the broader SyncQ OS ecosystem.

questions.question: What types of organizations are already interested in SyncQ?
questions.answer: The waitlist includes student organizations, entrepreneurship communities, university event committees, conference organizers, wedding planners, and businesses conducting large-scale events.

questions.question: Who are the founders?
questions.answer: Syncq Events is co-founded by Ayush Sanger and Abhinav Reddy.

questions.question: Is the platform web-only or will there be a native app later?
questions.answer: Currently SyncQ is web-based to maintain a no-install experience. Organizer apps may be introduced in the future.

questions.question: Do attendees need to create an account?
questions.answer: No lengthy signup is required. Attendees can access the event using their phone number and basic details.

questions.question: Do attendees need to download anything?
questions.answer: No downloads are required. Attendees simply scan a QR code or open a link.

questions.question: Can I use SyncQ for college fests, hackathons, conferences, and weddings?
questions.answer: Absolutely. SyncQ is designed for all kinds of large-scale events and gatherings.
